xmldoc.short_description: XML element object of an xmlDocument.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector: the XML content of the element, its own tags included.
a string: element name to search, or '*' for all elements.

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: the attribute value, or an empty char when the attribute does not exist.
a logical: true when the element has the attribute.
a character vector: all the text of the element and its descendants, joined.
an xmlNodeList object: matching descendant elements in document order.

description.p: xmlElement is the class of the elements returned by getDocumentElement, getElementsByTagName and the item method of an xmlNodeList.

An element is a read-only copy of a part of the document: its XML text is stored in the hidden property Text and its name in the hidden property Name. The constructor stores both values without checking them.

ul.li: getTagName and getNodeName return the element name.
getAttribute returns the value of an attribute of the element.
hasAttribute tells if the element has an attribute.
getTextContent returns the text of the element, without tags.
getElementsByTagName searches the descendants of the element; the element itself is not part of the result.
